english.title: Young person enter area from which excluded by section 182 - Gambling Act 2005
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a young person aged **(..SPECIFY AGE..), entered an area from which children and young persons were required to be excluded by virtue of section 182 of the Gambling Act 2005
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 49, 47(6) and 62(2)(b) of the Gambling Act 2005.

english.notes: Section 45 of the Gambling Act 2005 provides that "young person" means an individual aged 16 or 17.
